title: Addressing error under a selected-coordinate flip
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J$ be a set of coordinates in the cube $\\{−1,1\\}^{m+2^m}$, and let $g:\\{−1,1\\}^{m+2^m}\\to\\{−1,1\}$ depend only on the coordinates in $J$. For any input $x$ whose address-selected coordinate lies outside $J$, the sum of the error indicators of the addressing function and $g$, evaluated at $x$ and at the input obtained by flipping that selected coordinate, is at least $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates in the cube
$g$ is a Boolean function on the cube
$x$ is an input in the cube
the address-selected coordinate of $x$ is not in $J$
